story: Alex’s jaw clenched so tightly that his teeth ground together in a painful, rhythmic scrape. He stared at the crumpled report on his desk, the paper trembling slightly under his white-knuckled grip. A hot flush crept up his neck, prickling his skin like tiny needles, while his heart hammered against his ribs with frantic, uneven beats. He wanted to scream, to shatter the quiet office with a visceral roar, but he swallowed it down, letting the bile rise in his throat instead. The silence around him felt heavy and suffocating, amplifying the violent thrum of blood rushing in his ears as he forced himself to breathe, one shallow, jagged inhale at a time.

Alex’s jaw tightened until the muscles ached, a familiar tension coiling in his chest like a spring ready to snap. He stared at the crumpled letter on the desk, his fingers digging into the wood until his knuckles turned white. The silence in the room felt heavy, pressing against his eardrums with a low, buzzing hum that matched the pounding in his head. He took a sharp, ragged breath, holding it there as if trying to contain the heat rising up his neck. Without looking away from the paper, he slowly closed his eyes, letting the image of his face flush with heat spread through his veins.

Alex stared at the screen, his knuckles turning white as he gripped the edge of the desk with trembling force. The hum of the computer fan seemed to amplify into a deafening roar in his ears, drowning out any rational thought. He wanted to smash the keyboard, to feel the plastic shatter under his weight and release the pressure building behind his eyes. Instead, he took a sharp, jagged breath, forcing his shoulders down despite the tension coiling tightly in his neck. The coffee cup beside his hand shook slightly, sending ripples across the dark liquid, mirroring the chaotic storm raging within his chest.
